data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Chart.js Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js for data visualization within the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Chart.js is used to create pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rate visualizations.
Charts include line, bar, area, pie, and radar types.
Charts are interactive and include animations.

features.title: Real-Time Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard with various Chart.js graphs.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard includes line chart for LLM cost over time.
Includes bar chart for stage completion rates.
Includes area chart for success rate trends.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart includes TDD compliance and SOLID principles.
Metrics are clearly labeled and easy to interpret.
Chart is interactive and visually engaging.

features.title: HTML Presentation Creation
features.description: Develop a standalone HTML presentation showcasing Artemis capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation is a single HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript.
Uses existing demos as templates for structure and design.
Includes professional gradient background and smooth transitions.

features.title: Pipeline Visualization
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline is represented using a suitable chart type.
Stages are clearly labeled and visually distinct.
Pipeline visualization is interactive.

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality with navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set period.
Users can manually navigate slides using controls.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents supervisor integration data.
Chart is interactive and visually appealing.
Data is clearly labeled and easy to understand.
